<!-- pr-reviewer: 6f262d9a003772fb7a5662708e1a4f1f73ba7224 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The guide covers the tool library workflow and links it from the entry pages. The issue comment records all 57 reviewed PRs. The decision record explains the scope and the omitted process change.

I read the changed pages and checked the instructions against the source and tests. The checks included import modes, holder retention, tool numbers, alignment, post options, wire controls and sinker wear.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 6c33940d:
- Zola 0.23.6 build: passed. It rendered 43 pages and four sections with no broken internal links.
- The two external content tests: passed against this review worktree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. It selected no Rust tests because only documentation changed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- Rust crate tests and Clippy do not apply to this documentation change.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, simulation or collision checks. It moves no goldens. Safety mutations do not apply. I did not repeat the author's content mutations. This PR changes no UI code, so before and after screenshots do not apply.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
